name: Bodyweight Skullcrusher (Smith Machine)
description: A bodyweight triceps exercise performed under a fixed barbell in a Smith machine. The lifter positions their body at an angle and lowers their head toward the bar using elbow flexion, then presses back up. The fixed bar provides stability while body angle controls difficulty.

execution.starting_position: Set up for Bodyweight Skullcrusher (Smith Machine) in the appropriate position.
execution.setup_instructions: Prepare equipment and body position for Bodyweight Skullcrusher (Smith Machine).
steps: Step 1: Set Smith bar at hip height. Grip bar slightly narrower than shoulder width.
Step 2: Walk feet back so body is at an angle with arms extended.
Step 3: Keeping elbows stationary, lower head toward bar by bending elbows.
Step 4: Press back to start through triceps extension.
execution.breathing_instructions: Exhale during the exertion phase, inhale during the return.
common_mistakes: Moving hips instead of using elbows
safety_considerations: Keep joints aligned throughout the movement.
Use controlled weight appropriate for skill level.
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Move through full range of motion without compromising joint integrity.
